name: One date with a snake boy
source:
This short visual novel will show you one day (or rather evening) of an awkward couple who decided to go out on a date.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220803004706/https://loxushka-40.itch.io/one-date-with-a-snake-boy]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这部短篇视觉小说展现了一对笨拙情侣的一天，或者说，是一个傍晚。他们决定一起出去约会。

[来源：[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220803004706/https://loxushka-40.itch.io/one-date-with-a-snake-boy]Itch.io[/url]]
